title: Routing and cost audit
description: Dry-run and fake-transport metered routing decisions, recomputed from the raw L5 decision records. Declared-vs-actual cost is kept distinct in every case; unmetered cases are shown as null / 'not metered', never $0. Simulated metering from the local fake transport is labelled and never presented as real provider metering.

frozen_inputs.l5_datasets: 05-model-router/datasets (policy v13 + rules + capabilities seeds copied read-only; models and decision_log start empty)
frozen_inputs.fake_transport: experiments/fake_transport.py (loopback, never touches the network; NetworkGuard asserts 0 socket/urlopen calls)

fake_answered_metered.honesty_rule: every attempt's meter field carries the simulated label; the simulated number is never presented as real provider metering

declared_price_note: The fake connection declares local $0 input/output prices. A local $0 price is a USER DECLARATION, not a claim that energy or latency was measured (brief §3.3).
headline_result_recomputed_by_spine: Declared-vs-actual values kept distinct per case; unmetered cases shown as null; route/evidence coverage; simulated metering labelled; zero network calls.
